name: upstream_monero_fcmp_pp
description: Monero's own FCMP++ test proofs (1, 2, 4, 8 and 128 inputs), verbatim from its FCMP++ stressnet release. Every proof is valid for its signable transaction hash, tree root, layer count, pseudo-outputs and key images. The tree root is a Selene point when the layer count is odd and a Helios point when it is even. Used to check that the pinned monero-fcmp-plus-plus verifies proofs made by Monero's code, not only proofs it made itself.
